en: Color postcard showing a modernist building complex with angular concrete facades, large windows shaded by red awnings, landscaped lawns and paths in the foreground, and low hills in the background. The reverse side contains printed multilingual text identifying the place as the Olympia Restaurant in Pécs, handwritten Hungarian message and address, a green 40 fillér Hungarian postage stamp, and Pécs postmarks.
